Energy- efficient  house

homes and promoting environmentally responsible living.

WHAT’S NEW 4Q25 & YE25
NC x KKP
NC Housing Public Company Limited received the Sustainable Property Award from Kiatnakin Phatra Bank (KKP) under the
KKP Shaping Tomorrow 2025 initiative, reaffirming its commitment to sustainable residential development. The award
highlights the company’s dedication to environmentally responsible housing and enhancing residents’ quality of life under
the concept “Better Life, Better Community.”
